topic: Viet Nam's Contributions to International Organisations
prompt: Write a paragraph (120-150 words) describing how Viet Nam benefits from and contributes to international organisations such as the United Nations or ASEAN.
checklist: The paragraph has a clear topic sentence
The length is within the required 120–150 words
There are at least 2 supporting points with examples or explanations
Tenses and linking words are used correctly (Furthermore, However, In addition...)
There are no basic spelling or punctuation mistakes
model_essay: Active participation in international organisations has brought significant developmental benefits to Viet Nam while elevating its global standing. First, collaborating with United Nations agencies such as UNICEF and UNDP provides essential funding, technical expertise, and modern equipment to improve rural education and healthcare infrastructure. These partnerships have substantially enhanced the living standards of millions of Vietnamese citizens. In return, Viet Nam has transformed into an active and responsible contributor on the world stage. Our military medical units and peacekeepers participate successfully in UN peacekeeping missions in Africa, while our diplomats foster regional solidarity and free trade within ASEAN. In conclusion, active engagement in global governance not only accelerates Viet Nam's socioeconomic development but also demonstrates our firm commitment to international peace and sustainable development.
